physics.where_iam_law: register A8 (each cell type's own healthy IAM-A level), LOCATION LEAD: the held error is set by the balance of thermal loss against the restore crew paid in M = 20.94 thermal kicks per coin (A1, A4); a held mark copied late in S phase waits longer for the crew (late-S DNA is remethylated more slowly, Charlton 2018; loss concentrates in late-replicating, lamina-associated DNA, Zhou 2018, Ming 2020). If location sets each type's level, the between-type spread of held error sits in late-copied DNA and early-copied (open) DNA reads near the line M alone gives in every type.

instrument_check._meaning: rows_min: whole + three thirds read by the chain (or the third's partial-genome re-read) for the canary library; halves_corr_min: min/max of the whole-library held error and the mean of the three thirds' held errors; hours: per library

cosmologist.method: split the same detector's reading by sky region: each library's own molecules divided by replication timing and read by the same chain, so lab, donor, depth and instrument cancel between the thirds
cosmologist.null_test: planted uniform loss through the same splitter and count must give late/early 1.00 within 0.03 (synthetic NULL), and the thirds' mean must match the whole library within 5 % on real data

value.question: does the between-type spread of IAM-A's held error sit in late-copied DNA (location sets each type's level, A8L2) or equally in early and late (location is out)?
value.adequate: 12 types with whole-library A from 0.73 to 1.05: a late/early spread ratio's bootstrap interval over types decides whether late carries more of the spread
